parts.text: Calculate my 1-Rep Max if I benched 225 lbs for 5 reps, and give me my 90% and 80% working weight recommendations.
Based on 225 lbs for 5 reps, the estimated 1RM is approximately 260-262 lbs (Epley formula: 225 * (1 + 5/30) = 262.5 lbs). 90% is ~235 lbs and 80% is ~210 lbs.

function_declarations.description:
Search or list exercises in the catalog stored in Firestore.

Args:
    query: Optional keyword to search within exercise name, primary muscle, or equipment.
    category: Optional category filter (e.g. 'Chest', 'Legs', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Arms').

Returns:
    A list of matching exercise dictionaries from Firestore.
function_declarations.name: search_exercises

function_declarations.description:
Get full details and form cues for a specific exercise from Firestore.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name or identifier of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Bench Press', 'pull-ups').

Returns:
    The exercise record with form cues and specifications, or an error dictionary if not found.
function_declarations.name: get_exercise_details

function_declarations.description:
Add a new exercise into the Firestore catalog.

Args:
    name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Incline Dumbbell Press').
    category: Category (e.g. 'Chest', 'Legs', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Arms').
    primary_muscle: Targeted main muscle (e.g. 'Upper Pectorals').
    equipment: Equipment needed (e.g. 'Dumbbells, Adjustable Bench').
    form_cues: Step-by-step coaching cues for proper posture and execution.
    default_sets_reps: Standard recommended sets and reps (e.g. '3-4 sets of 8-10 reps').
    difficulty: Difficulty level ('Beginner', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced').

Returns:
    Confirmation dictionary with the created exercise details and document ID.
function_declarations.name: add_exercise

function_declarations.description:
Calculate estimated 1-Rep Max (1RM) and working weight percentages.

Args:
    weight_lbs: The weight lifted in pounds (lbs).
    reps: The number of repetitions completed (>= 1).

Returns:
    A dictionary with estimated 1RM, working weight percentages, and estimated rep maxes.
function_declarations.name: calculate_one_rep_max

function_declarations.description:
Log a workout session to Firestore, compute volume load, and update PR if achieved.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise performed (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat').
    sets: Number of sets completed.
    reps: Number of reps per set.
    weight_lbs: Weight used in pounds (lbs).
    notes: Optional session observations (e.g. 'RPE 8, felt smooth').

Returns:
    Session confirmation details including total volume load and new PR status.
function_declarations.name: log_workout_session

function_declarations.description:
Generate a sleek, dark-themed visual progression chart showing 1RM and volume load progression over time.

Args:
    exercise_name: The name of the exercise (e.g. 'Deadlift', 'Bench Press', 'Squat').
    metric: The primary metric to highlight ('estimated_1rm' or 'volume_load').
    tool_context: ADK ToolContext for artifact generation.

Returns:
    A dictionary with image_url, chart_summary, and session statistics.
function_declarations.name: generate_progress_chart

function_declarations.description:
Consult evidence-based sports science guidelines for hypertrophy, volume landmarks, rest intervals, and fatigue management.

Args:
    query: Specific exercise science question (e.g. 'optimal rest between heavy sets', 'hypertrophy volume landmarks', 'RPE vs RIR guidance').

Returns:
    Evidence-based sports science guidelines and recommendations.
function_declarations.name: consult_training_science

function_declarations.description:
Generate an anatomical posture and form guide diagram for an exercise, saving as an artifact and uploading to public Cloud Storage.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat', 'Romanian Deadlift').
    focus_cue: Specific biomechanics cue to emphasize (e.g. 'spine neutral and bar over midfoot').
    tool_context: ToolContext injected by the agent framework for artifact persistence.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing status, exercise_name, public image_url, and description.
function_declarations.name: generate_exercise_form_image

function_declarations.description:
Generate a short coaching video clip demonstrating proper exercise movement and cadence using Google's Omni model (gemini-omni-flash-preview).

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat', 'Romanian Deadlift').
    focus_cue: Motion cue to emphasize (e.g. 'controlled eccentric, explosive drive, neutral spine').
    tool_context: ToolContext injected by the agent framework for artifact persistence.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing status, exercise_name, public video_url, and description.
function_declarations.name: generate_exercise_motion_video

function_declarations.description:
Retrieve personal records (PRs) from Firestore.

Args:
    exercise_name: Optional exercise name to filter PRs. If omitted, returns all PRs.

Returns:
    A list of personal record dictionaries.
function_declarations.name: get_personal_records

function_declarations.description:
Record or update a Personal Record (PR) for an exercise in Firestore.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Bench Press').
    weight_lbs: Weight achieved in pounds (lbs).
    reps: Repetitions performed (defaults to 1 for 1RM).
    notes: Optional notes on the lift (e.g. 'Paused rep, felt strong').

Returns:
    Confirmation dictionary containing the stored PR record.
function_declarations.name: record_personal_record

function_declarations.description:
Fetches real nutritional values and macros for a food item or supplement (e.g. 'whey protein', 'oats', 'chicken breast') from the Open Food Facts public API.

Args:
    food_item: Name of the food item or supplement to look up.

Returns:
    Dict containing product name, brand, protein, carbs, fat, and calories per 100g.
function_declarations.name: fetch_nutrition_facts

function_declarations.description:
Fetches anatomical muscle information and scientific diagrams from the WGER Workout Manager public API.

Args:
    muscle_name: Optional muscle name (e.g., 'Biceps', 'Hamstrings', 'Shoulders', 'Glutes') to filter by.

Returns:
    Dict containing anatomical muscle names, front/back positioning, and diagram URLs.
function_declarations.name: lookup_external_muscle_info

function_declarations.description:
Search or list exercises in the catalog stored in Firestore.

Args:
    query: Optional keyword to search within exercise name, primary muscle, or equipment.
    category: Optional category filter (e.g. 'Chest', 'Legs', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Arms').

Returns:
    A list of matching exercise dictionaries from Firestore.
function_declarations.name: search_exercises

function_declarations.description:
Get full details and form cues for a specific exercise from Firestore.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name or identifier of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Bench Press', 'pull-ups').

Returns:
    The exercise record with form cues and specifications, or an error dictionary if not found.
function_declarations.name: get_exercise_details

function_declarations.description:
Add a new exercise into the Firestore catalog.

Args:
    name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Incline Dumbbell Press').
    category: Category (e.g. 'Chest', 'Legs', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Arms').
    primary_muscle: Targeted main muscle (e.g. 'Upper Pectorals').
    equipment: Equipment needed (e.g. 'Dumbbells, Adjustable Bench').
    form_cues: Step-by-step coaching cues for proper posture and execution.
    default_sets_reps: Standard recommended sets and reps (e.g. '3-4 sets of 8-10 reps').
    difficulty: Difficulty level ('Beginner', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced').

Returns:
    Confirmation dictionary with the created exercise details and document ID.
function_declarations.name: add_exercise

function_declarations.description:
Calculate estimated 1-Rep Max (1RM) and working weight percentages.

Args:
    weight_lbs: The weight lifted in pounds (lbs).
    reps: The number of repetitions completed (>= 1).

Returns:
    A dictionary with estimated 1RM, working weight percentages, and estimated rep maxes.
function_declarations.name: calculate_one_rep_max

function_declarations.description:
Log a workout session to Firestore, compute volume load, and update PR if achieved.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise performed (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat').
    sets: Number of sets completed.
    reps: Number of reps per set.
    weight_lbs: Weight used in pounds (lbs).
    notes: Optional session observations (e.g. 'RPE 8, felt smooth').

    Session confirmation details including total volume load and new PR status.

function_declarations.description:

    exercise_name: The name of the exercise (e.g. 'Deadlift', 'Bench Press', 'Squat').
    metric: The primary metric to highlight ('estimated_1rm' or 'volume_load').
    tool_context: ADK ToolContext for artifact generation.

Returns:
    A dictionary with image_url, chart_summary, and session statistics.
function_declarations.name: generate_progress_chart

function_declarations.description:
Consult evidence-based sports science guidelines for hypertrophy, volume landmarks, rest intervals, and fatigue management.

Args:
    query: Specific exercise science question (e.g. 'optimal rest between heavy sets', 'hypertrophy volume landmarks', 'RPE vs RIR guidance').

Returns:
    Evidence-based sports science guidelines and recommendations.
function_declarations.name: consult_training_science

function_declarations.description:

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat', 'Romanian Deadlift').

    focus_cue: Motion cue to emphasize (e.g. 'controlled eccentric, explosive drive, neutral spine').
    tool_context: ToolContext injected by the agent framework for artifact persistence.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing status, exercise_name, public video_url, and description.

function_declarations.description:

function_declarations.description:

response.result:
Evidence-Based Sports Science Guidelines:
# EVIDENCE-BASED STRENGTH & HYPERTROPHY TRAINING SCIENCE MANUAL

## SECTION 1: HYPERTROPHY VOLUME LANDMARKS & SET PROGRESSION
- Maintenance Volume (MV): The minimum volume required to preserve existing muscular mass. For most trained lifters, this is 6-8 direct working sets per muscle group per week.
- Minimum Effective Volume (MEV): The smallest dose of training volume that induces measurable hypertrophy gains. Typically 10-12 direct sets per muscle group per week.
- Maximum Adaptive Volume (MAV): The optimal volume range where the greatest rate of muscular hypertrophy occurs. Typically 14-22 direct sets per muscle group per week, split across 2-4 training sessions.
- Maximum Recoverable Volume (MRV): The upper limit of training volume from which an athlete can recover and adapt. Exceeding MRV (typically >22-26 sets per week depending on systemic fatigue) results in overreaching and eventual strength loss.

## SECTION 2: INTER-SET REST INTERVALS
- Compound Multi-Joint Lifts (Squat, Deadlift, Bench Press, Overhead Press): 
  - Rest requirement: 2 to 5 minutes.
  - Scientific justification: Heavy compound movements place high demands on the central nervous system (CNS) and phosphocreatine (ATP-CP) replenishment. Studies (e.g., Schoenfeld et al.) demonstrate that resting >=3 minutes produces greater strength gains and superior total volume compared to short (1-minute) rest periods.
- Isolation & Accessory Lifts (Bicep Curls, Lateral Raises, Tricep Pushdowns, Leg Extensions):
  - Rest requirement: 60 to 90 seconds.
  - Scientific justification: Lower systemic fatigue allows faster metabolic recovery while maintaining adequate mechanical tension on target muscle fibers.

## SECTION 3: PROXIMITY TO FAILURE & RPE / RIR FRAMEWORK
- RPE (Rating of Perceived Exertion) and RIR (Reps in Reserve):
  - RPE 10 (0 RIR): Complete muscular failure; no additional repetitions could be completed with acceptable form.
  - RPE 9 (1 RIR): 1 repetition left before failure. Excellent for peak strength stimuli and final sets of compound work.
  - RPE 8 (2 RIR): 2 repetitions left before failure. The golden standard for hypertrophy training (balance of high mechanical tension and manageable fatigue).
  - RPE 7 (3 RIR): 3 repetitions left before failure. Ideal for sub-maximal technical volume or power/speed work.
- Recommendation: The majority of working sets should be performed within 1-3 RIR (RPE 7-9) to stimulate muscle protein synthesis without inducing disproportionate neuromusc
